description: This file defines an abstract class ContentObserverDictionary that extends BTreeDictionary, managing content observation and background reloading of dictionary data in an Android application.

classes.name: ContentObserverDictionary
classes.description: An abstract class that observes content changes via a URI and manages background reloading of dictionary data accordingly.

methods.name: ContentObserverDictionary
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dictionary with a name, context, and optional URI to observe for changes.

methods.name: loadAllResources
methods.description: Loads resources and sets up observation of content URI if available.

methods.name: onStorageChanged
methods.description: Handles storage change events by resetting the dictionary and reloading data in the background.

methods.name: closeAllResources
methods.description: Disposes of resources and subscriptions when closing the dictionary.
